media.alt_text: Overview graphic for Portree, Isle of Skye with gluten-free travel stats over a Highland landscape photo

caption.body:
Didn't expect a small harbour town on a Scottish island to have this many GF options, but Portree was genuinely good. 11 restaurants tested, three scoring 5/5 on my GF safety scale, and several places with dedicated fryers and GF bread.

Also: the Quiraing, Fairy Pools, and some of the most dramatic landscape I've seen anywhere.

Full Portree guide on the site (link in bio).
